response.original_title: VOY : The Unseen Journey of Women's Blind Footballers of India
response.overview: Blindness doesn’t define these women-Football does. VOY captures the incredible journey of Women Blind Footballers In India, who play not with sight, but with instinct, sound, and trust. Their path hasn’t been easy, but with the support of Mai Bal Bhavan, an NGO in Pune, Maharashtra, dedicated to empowering them, players like Deepali, Komal, and many others have found confidence, purpose, and a place in the game. Through their stories, this film challenges perceptions of disability in sports and celebrates the courage, passion, and resilience of those who refuse to be sidelined. With creative editing of VOY, this film tries to make a sighted person feel and view as blind.
response.tagline: Blindness doesn’t define these women-Football does.
